Servex/ext/remote/doc/cloud-voice-agent.md:19 still says the untitled record is "Made by `RemoteMCP.voice_session()` on the first call of the day". Servex/ext/remote/doc/voice-logging.md:3 still says "one folder per cloud voice agent per day". Both are now stale: the code continues the record in use across midnight. Point both lines at the new paragraph at voice-logging.md:29.

The comment block at Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.js:196-197 still opens with "One folder per cloud voice agent per day … <name> is … else the caller + date". The new paragraph below it contradicts that first sentence. Reword the first sentence so the block says one thing.

voice-logging.md:29 says "a longer gap opens another", but that is not always true. After a gap of more than 2 hours, an untitled call goes to `cloud-voice-app-<today>`. If that record already exists today, it is reused, so two separate untitled chats on the same day still share one record (RemoteMCP.js:212). Either say so in the doc, or add a suffix after a gap.

The task t15 record has only the `add` line: no log and no close with an outcome. The brief also asks for parts (1)–(3), the proposal, the 11-06/11-07 link and the count of midnight crossings. Only the doc paragraph shows they were done. Close t15 with evidence once it is merged.

Saving only when `moved`, and writing `last` on the existing per-connection save at line 366, would be enough. The current version is correct, though.

The code looks right. `live` requires the store row to exist, a known id keeps its own folder (`store.map[id]?.file`), and the `caller:voice-app` key is safe in remote.sessions.json, because nothing iterates that map (git grep: only RemoteMCP.js reads it). `node Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.test.mjs` in the voice-sticky worktree prints `ok 7 calls`.
